notes.title: 🧠 The Clarity Update (Version 1.0.5) 🧠
notes.content:
Woop woop! The first week since the game's release has passed. We are still so very excited and happy to see that no more major issues have come up. So, by now, it's down to smaller visual glitches, quality of life improvements. All of us Spoons are so happy that y'all enjoy Bauhaus Bonk so much! 💕 We received amazing reviews (all positive so far 🤯) from players, as well as curators and also some press. The game is present on Twitch and Youtube and the Soundtrack is being listened to on all platforms, in short: we are over the moon! Thank you all, and keep bonkin'! 😊


Changelog

General:

 Added a big fat category selector on the level end screen (hopefully clearly communicating the existence of all four leaderboard categories)
 Re-arranged the gameplay settings a bit, so they are sorted by importance.
 Added "Show Controls" screen, reachable via the options menu


Quality of Life:

 Press G (or left trigger) to temporarily toggle the Ghost's visibility


Bugfixes:

 Artisan, Perfectionist and Courier achievements now work as intended
 Adjusted the descriptions of Prodigy and Perfectionist achievements
 Visual win rotation bug fixed
 Sometimes the game would lock/break when spamming "R" right before the goal
 Adjusted “S+” grade requirement for level 24
 All kinds of minor fixes


Known issues:

 Camera lags far behind Walter or snaps to him way too fast (more reports and info from y'all is very welcome! 🔍)
 The buttons for switching tabs (settings and leaderboard) are not yet displayed where they are most relevant

notes.title: 🎶 Soundtrack Release! 🎶 / The Bonk Update (Version 1.0.4)
notes.content:
The Bauhaus Bonk Soundtrack is now available, here on Steam! 💃🪩🕺

It took a couple of days longer to go through the publishing process, but here we are: All the banger songs from the game are available on Steam now! Buying it here will support us a lot, but you can also listen to it on Spotify (over there, we even have two songs which haven't made it into the game yet). Also available as the Bounce 'n Bonk Bundle. 🥳

Other than that, we are still pushing out smaller fixes and improvements.


The Bonk Update (Version 1.0.4)

General:

 Improved accuracy for run times
 Bonk Setting
 Changed the displayed compatible Mac version, as we became aware that the game is not as downwards-compatible as we had hoped


Fixed bugs:

 Timing issue, where hitting escape while finishing the level caused an error
 Wrong leaderboard category gets displayed when opening a leaderboard from the level select
 Leaving the game running for a long time causes Walter to drift across the level
 In Party mode: Entering a name with an "R" in it, restarts the level


(Still) Known issues:

 Camera lags far behind Walter or snaps to him way too fast (more reports and info from y'all is very welcome! 🔍)
 The 4 Leaderboard categories are not clearly communicated
 Steamdeck: D-Pad doesn't work reliably (still only had one instance of that, let us know if you encounter it! 👂)

notes.title: The Mupdate (Version 1.0.3)
notes.content:
Hey folks! Quick first day patch to address the most urgent issues.

Important note for you record hunters out there. The game doesn't communicate it very well yet (but we're working on it): There are four leaderboards for each level. The game shows you the most fitting one. The leaderboard categories are the same as the ghost categories (fastest time, fastest time 100%, least steps and least steps 100%). Enjoy the race!

Changelog

General

 Settings overhaul
 New graphic settings (resolution, V-Sync, window mode)
 Some achievements now unlock during the level instead of at the end
 Leaderboards load a bit quicker


Fixed Bugs

 Online mode not available in demo / empty level select screen
 Displayed ghost times are rounded up


(Still) Known issues

 Camera lags behind Walter
 Leaderboards are hard to understand
 Steam Deck: D-Pad doesn't work reliably(?)


We will continue to push small updates for the next few days, so please don't hesitate to bring any bugs to our attention in our community Discord or this Airtable form.

notes.title: Known Issues We're Fixing – Updates Incoming!
notes.content:
We launched our first game 🥄

Although we did a good amount of testing before launching to ensure a smooth release, you guys have already told us about some bugs we missed. Thank you for that!
We are currently working on fixing them as soon as possible. If you encounter any further bugs, be sure to let us know either on our community Discord  or in our bug report form over on Airtable.

We know about these bugs already 🐛

 Demo doesn't support online mode and rarely there's an issue where the level-select screen doesn't show any levels
 In some cases, the resolution on Steam Deck does not work quite right
 Long leaderboard loading times
 Steam Deck: D-Pad does not work reliably
 Other small miscallaneous things


We will push some new QoL changes with the next update as well and will let you guys know about it in the upcoming patchnotes! Steamworks is also giving us a hard time right now to upload new versions. We're trying our best to be as fast as possible.

Thank you for playing our game; we sincerely hope you enjoy your time!

notes.title: BAUHAUS BONK OUT NOW!
notes.content:
You can play Bauhaus Bonk!

We are unbelievably excited to share our baby with y'all 🥄 Wether you want to grind high scores or take a relaxing waddle through Bauhaus artworks, the game is all yours now!

Here's our release trailer 
[previewyoutube=L-tPJaK06a0;full][/previewyoutube]

What is in the game, you ask?

 54 bonkable levels with rapidly increasing difficulty 🎮
 global and Steam friendlist highscores in four different categories - speed, speed any %, step-count, and step-count any % 🏆
 Gameplay modifiers, such as Bauhaus color swap eyes, speed-ups, slow-downs, shapeshifters, and phasers 👁
 4 extra swingy Electroswing tracks by the fabulous Juan Orjuela, scoredEarth, Timcat, and Jannik Schmidt 🎵


Thank you for your playing our game!

notes.title: Major Demo Update on Bauhaus Bonk Release Day, February 6th
notes.content:
Bauhaus Bonk will launch February 6th and we're using the occasion to update the demo as well! 

Levels and Leaderboard Reset
We're updating the levels so the demo is just as shiny as the game is! That means the current high scores are no longer representative. This is why we'll be wiping the leaderboards with the update. So commemorate your current high scores, grab the title before time runs out, and get ready to claim all new titles. 

Polish
Everything is shinier, cleaner, better! Go watch the trailer if you'd like to get more details:
[previewyoutube=O20hBmGkeVc;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Bauhaus Bonk Will Be Out February 6th
notes.content:

notes.title: Small demo updates
notes.content:
Hey People,

just a very small update today, but we still wanted to keep you in the loop!

Changes on the 0.1.0.5 Version:

 Fixed a visual bug where Walter was looking a bit funky
 Default language is now set to English if your system language is not either set to Spanish or German (thanks to the person pointing this out in a community post!)

notes.title: Minor demo tweaks and updates
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

here's a quick overview of what's new in this update:

Changes:

 Tweaked and added spanish translations
 Overhauled badges on the end screen


Thanks to your playtesting, we also tackled a few bugs:

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed: sound effects not stopping after completing level
 Fixed: overlapping sound
 Fixed: end level overview time differentiating from the leaderboard time


Thank you all again for playing our demo and for your valuable feedback and bug reports. We hope you’re having a great time bonking!

Please feel free to share any additional feedback!
